whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm requirements.txt no longer carries an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release.
